appleAppStore.subtitle: AI Personal Trainer & PT Marketplace
appleAppStore.description:
Flexora Fitnes is your complete AI-powered personal training platform and global PT marketplace. Book verified, certified personal trainers from anywhere in the world, or train with our AI coach that offers real-time form correction via video, 3D muscle visualization, voice guidance, and automatic rep counting.

FEATURES:
• AI-PT with real-time form correction
• 3D muscle map visualization
• Voice-guided workouts
• Global PT marketplace — book verified trainers worldwide
• Speed-date matching to find your ideal trainer
• Nutrition scanner and meal tracking
• Custom workout plan builder
• Global competitions with live leaderboards
• Direct messaging with trainers
• Music integration for workouts

SUBSCRIPTIONS:
• Basic (~149 NOK/mo): plans, chat, ranking, nutrition scanner, music, competitions
• Hybrid (~249 NOK/mo): + AI-PT, create groups, arrange competitions
• Premium (~399 NOK/mo): + live video, form correction, breath tracking, 1:1 PT sessions

PTs can register and market themselves globally for ~199 NOK/mo.
